true_answer: According to general relativity, time also runs slower in stronger gravitational ﬁelds; this is gravitational time dilation.[99] e eﬀect of the dilation becomes more noticeable in a mass-dense object. As a consequence of how gravitational ﬁelds warp spacetime, the subject will experience gravitational time dilation. From the perspective of the subject itself, they will experience time normally.
